scope: Research decision audit using historical repository results and current C-solver t2 geometry; no replacement solver or production modification.
constraints: Retain existing C/CUDA/OpenMP implementation and long-run reference
Weights allowed, but prior DAE secular failure must not be ignored

historical_evidence.finding: Strong residual dissipation needed to suppress modes previously caused excessive heating; simple smoothed volumes did not meet long-time target.
Material-volume-following Laguerre weights grew secularly and suppression degraded near t10, even with cleaned periodic boundaries.
Independent thermodynamic volumes require a new compatible model; variational restoration requires energy accounting and tests of artificial elasticity.

candidate_status: Kinematic evidence supports evaluating a reconstructed-divergence operator, but no conservative or stable evolution is established. A smaller divergence alone is not sufficient.

derived_contract.definition: Vdot = B(q,V) v; Udot_i = -P_i (B v)_i; F_pressure = transpose(B) P; qdot=v; particle masses fixed.
derived_contract.energy_identity: v^T F_pressure + sum(Udot) = v^T B^T P - P^T B v = 0 at the semidiscrete instantaneous level. This does not imply exact finite-step RK4 conservation.
derived_contract.linear_momentum: B applied to either uniform translation mode must vanish, with boundary traction accounted separately.
derived_contract.angular_momentum: B applied to rigid rotation velocity must vanish for a closed nonperiodic system; periodic/frozen boundaries require their own torque accounting.
derived_contract.constant_pressure_and_volume: For a closed volume partition, 1^T B=0 is needed both for constant total volume and to make B^T P0*1 vanish. Raw local least-squares divergence does not automatically meet this condition.
derived_contract.consistency: Affine velocity divergence and compression/expansion must be reproduced; smooth Kepler flow must not be special-cased.
remaining: Construct the actual coefficients and their transpose, rather than changing only the pressure or volume formula.
Check conservation identities, constant-pressure response, translation and rotation modes, and volume positivity.
Assess whether an independent thermodynamic volume remains physically compatible with geometric volume and boundary transport.
Only then evaluate evolved snapshots and complete t6-t10+ runs, shocks and resolution dependence.

decision: Do not reactivate historical DAE or strengthen damping blindly. Do not substitute stored gradient divergence into the current energy equation. Next research gate is feasibility of a compatible operator, with existing physical long runs preserved.
